title: Customer Service Officer
summary:
Recruit Masters is proudly partnering with a Queensland-owned company specialising in water purification systems. We’re on the hunt for a confident and organised Customer Service Officer who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys variety in their day. 

About the Role 
You’ll be the heartbeat of the office — managing customer enquiries, coordinating technician runs, 
processing sales, and keeping operations on track. This is a hands-on role perfect for someone who loves working with people and isn’t afraid to jump in where needed. 

What You’ll Be Doing 
• Be the first point of contact for customers — in person, over the phone, and by email. 
• Manage orders, bookings, and customer quotes. 
• Process payments and sales transactions. 
• Prepare technician schedules and liaise with couriers. 
• Support stock control and warehouse operations. 

What We’re Looking For 
Friendly, reliable, and great with people. Customer service or admin experience preferred. Strong computer skills and attention to detail. A current driver’s licence is required. 

Why You’ll Love It 
• Training and development opportunities. 
• Chance to grow into a leadership role. 

Apply Now

title: Food Process
summary:
Food Process & Machine Operator – Carole Park location

What’s the gig?
Our food-manufacturing clients (think household names) needs switched-on operators and food process workers to keep the lines humming across their Carole Park site.

Day to day
* Setting up, running and tweaking high-speed processing & packing machinery
* Handling raw meat on halal-certified lines 
* Quality checks that’d make your mum proud – temp, weight, seals, the works
* Cleaning & sanitising gear so the food-safety auditors stay happy
* Teaming up with crew and supervisors to smash shift targets safely

Shift options
✅Day shifts:kick-off 4.15am - 1.45pm
✅Arvo shifts:start around 1:45pm - 10.30pm till late
✅Lock in a regular roster – show us you’re reliable 

You’ll fit right in if you…
✅Have previous food-processing or machine-operating experience (bonus points for both)
✅Can lift 20+ kg and stay on your feet all shift
✅Understand HACCP/GMP basics – or are keen to learn fast
✅Can pass a pre-employment medical, drug & alcohol test and reference checks
✅Bring great attitude, solid work ethic, and zero drama – simple!
✅Own RELIABLE transportation

Why jump on board?
* Steady hours with overtime when production peaks
* Work with industry-leading brands (looks good on the résumé)
* Supportive supervisors, and genuine pathways to permanent hire 
* Weekly pay and occasional!

Sound like your next move?

title: Pick Packer

Temp to perm role with a competitive hourly rate of $32.76
Opportunity to work for a global transportation and logistics company
Chance to develop valuable skills in a dynamic, team-oriented environment
